verdict.rationale: Typesense is a search engine/database, not an agentic system that itself consumes external tools via MCP. The evidence shows Typesense Cloud instead exposes an MCP *server* so external AI agents can call Typesense's own tools (docs-43) — the reverse role from what this story asks. Being a client that plugs in other MCP servers is not a fair capability to expect of a search infrastructure product.
